notes.subject: יד חזית
notes.rationale: 'whose hand you saw' — most take יד as euphemism for genitals (JPS 'whose hand', BSB 'nakedness'); kept literal 'han yu lukim'.

notes.subject: זכרונך
notes.rationale: 'memorial/symbol' — cultic emblem behind the door (KJV 'remembrance') vs phallic symbol reading; rendered descriptively.

notes.subject: גלית מאתי
notes.rationale: 'you uncovered yourself from another than me' (KJV, taking מאתי with following verb) vs 'you removed from me' (YLT); rendered as departing from me.

notes.subject: to apostate Judah
notes.rationale: Second-person accusation continues throughout, apostasy framed as adultery.

translation: Na bihainim dua na post bilong dua, yu putim sampela samting bilong tingim yu; longen, long ⟨את⟩ mi yu lusim, na yu go antap, yu wanemim bed bilong yu; na yu wokim kontrak long ol; yu laikim bed bilong ol — han yu lukim.
